The '''Quarren fishing vessel''' was a [[fishing]] [[Boat|vessel]] used by a [[Quarren]] [[Unidentified Quarren boatman|boatman]] and his crew on the [[moon]] of [[Trask]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. It had a mast and a [[mamacore]] cage.<ref name="Handbook" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The boat first appeared in the [[Chapter 11: The Heiress|eleventh]] episode of the series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''.<ref name="Chapter 11">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 11: The Heiress}}</ref>
